mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_authorization_acting_grant (id, principal_issuer, principal_subject_id, principal_type, agent_id, agent_version, scope_kind, workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{issuer}, #{subjectId}, 'USER', #{agentId}, #{agentVersion}, #{scopeKind}, #{workspaceId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, 'ACTIVE', 1, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, principal_issuer, principal_subject_id, principal_type, agent_id, agent_version, scope_kind, workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id, valid_from, valid_until, status, version FROM ainer_authorization_acting_grant WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_authorization_acting_grant SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, revoked_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
